issue_request: FHIR-50768 was an Applied, Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core StructureDefinition request asking whether organization-preferredContact could be adapted for broader use, such as patient contacts. The approved PA resolution deprecated organization-preferredContact and updated patient-contactPriority so it could apply to ExtendedContactDetail while retaining Patient.contact and using generalized contact-priority wording.
